title: CRM Marketing Specialist
description:
CRM Marketing Specialist

Location: Hybrid (Midlands-based, with access to our Leicester and Birmingham offices)

Salary: £30,000 - £34,000 per annum, DOE

Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent

What We Can Offer You: 25 Days Annual Leave (Pro-Rata for Part-time and Fixed-Term Roles), Additional Holiday Purchase, Hybrid Working, Performance-Related Bonus, Life Assurance, Vitality Private Healthcare, Subsidised Gym Memberships, Cycle to Work scheme, Discount Vouchers and Access to Wellbeing Resources

Why Do We Want You

Are you a marketing professional who loves bringing campaigns to life

Do you enjoy the detail behind flawless campaign execution while also having the creativity to craft compelling content across multiple channels

We are Wilmington plc, and we're looking for a CRM Specialist to become the backbone of our marketing function.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced B2 B environment, enjoys working with marketing technology, and takes pride in delivering high-quality campaigns with real commercial impact.

You'll play a pivotal role in building, deploying, and coordinating campaigns across multiple business units, while adapting content into engaging assets that support lead generation, customer engagement, and business growth.

Please note: To complete your application, you will be redirected to Wilmington plc's career site.

At Wilmington plc, we celebrate individuality and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. As a Disability Confident employer, we shortlist all applicants who meet the essential role criteria and guarantee an interview for candidates with disabilities who meet these criteria. For reasonable adjustments or to apply under our interview guarantee scheme, please use the contact details provided once you have clicked "apply"!

Job purpose, tasks and responsibilities

As our CRM Specialist, you'll ensure campaigns are executed accurately, efficiently, and on time.

Working closely with colleagues across marketing - content, creative, performance, and business unit leads - you'll help turn marketing plans into effective multi-channel campaigns.

You'll be responsible for:
- Building and deploying campaigns through various digital channels, including email, web, paid media, and social media.
- Setting up campaign tracking, attribution, audience segmentation, and reporting structures.
- Performing thorough quality assurance checks across campaign assets, links, tracking codes, and customer journeys.
- Creating and adapting tactical marketing content including email copy, social media posts, CTAs, landing pages, and promotional assets.
- Repurposing strategic content into engaging, channel-specific marketing materials.
- Coordinating campaign timelines and asset delivery across multiple stakeholders.
- Managing multiple concurrent campaigns across various Business Units.
- Monitoring live campaigns and escalating critical issues where required.
- Maintaining campaign documentation and supporting continuous process improvement initiatives.
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure campaigns launch smoothly and perform effectively.

What's the Best Thing About This Role

You'll sit at the heart of the marketing function, working across multiple brands and business units while seeing your work translated into live campaigns that drive measurable results. Every day brings something different, offering a fantastic blend of marketing technology, project coordination, content creation, and stakeholder engagement.

What's the Most Challenging Thing About This Role

Balancing multiple campaign launches, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously requires exceptional organisation and attention to detail. Success comes from prioritising effectively while maintaining consistently high standards of quality and accuracy.

Essential and desirable capabilities

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- Experience using Marketo or a similar marketing automation/email marketing platform.
- Experience writing, editing, and repurposing marketing content across multiple channels.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience in a campaign execution or email marketing role, ideally within a B2 B environment.
- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify and resolve issues before campaigns go live.
- An understanding of email marketing best practices, audience segmentation, and campaign deployment.
- The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

To be successful in this role, it would be great if you have:
- Understanding of Google Analytics, Power BI, and A/B testing methodologies.
- Basic HTML knowledge for email and landing page troubleshooting.
- Experience supporting paid media campaigns and channels.
- Experience within a B2 B, professional services, training, events, or information services environment.
- Familiarity with social media management platforms and marketing technology tools.

We know it's not a skill, but the successful candidate must have permission to work in the role's location by the start of their employment.

Wilmington plc is a dynamic and expanding group of companies with a common aim - turning knowledge into advantage. We provide information and training to professional business markets within the Risk & Compliance, Finance, Legal and Insight sectors.

title: Influencer & Community Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Influencer & Community Marketing Executive - Trade & DIY Sector

Location: Birmingham (Remote with travel)
Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 + Bonus
Hours: 8am-5pm (Flexible, but need to join a daily huddle daily at 8.15am)

Holidays: 24 days + statutory (4 days to be used during Christmas shutdown)

Are you the kind of person who naturally builds relationships wherever you go, and turns conversations into long-term partnerships?
Do you thrive in fast-paced, hands-on environments where you can get out on-site, create content, and grow a brand community from the ground up?

If this sounds like you, a fast-growing, innovative chemical manufacturer within the trade and DIY space is looking for an Influencer & Community Marketing Executive to help take their brand presence to the next level.

About the Company

This high-growth, entrepreneurial business has already built an impressive brand with millions of social impressions and strong national retail presence. With ambitious plans to scale significantly over the next few years, they're investing in building a loyal, authentic community of brand advocates across the trade and DIY market. You'll join a young, energetic team where collaboration, visibility, and a sense of humour are part of everyday life.

What's the role about?

This is a people-first, relationship-driven role where you'll become the face of the brand across the influencer and trade community. You'll:
- Build and grow a network of influencers, tradespeople and DIY creators
- Create and deliver engaging content alongside influencers and customers
- Represent the brand at trade events, on-site visits and networking opportunities
- Support sales activity by strengthening relationships with customers and partners
- Drive community engagement across social platforms and campaigns

Key Responsibilities
- Identify, recruit, and nurture relationships with influencers and brand ambassadors
- Manage influencer gifting, campaigns, and ongoing engagement
- Create and collaborate on high-performing social media content
- Visit sites, workshops, and merchant branches to capture authentic product use
- Organise influencer events, brand experiences, and trade show activity
- Grow online communities and encourage user-generated content and advocacy
- Track performance metrics including engagement, views, and influencer activity

Requirements

About You

You're someone who:
- Is naturally outgoing, confident, and thrives on building relationships
- Has experience working with influencers, communities, or brand advocates
- Understands (or has a genuine interest in) the trade, construction, or DIY sector
- Is hands-on with content creation and social media platforms
- Is highly organised and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Enjoys getting out into the field-meeting people, filming content, and representing a brand
- Thinks commercially and understands how marketing supports sales growth

Benefits

What's in it for you?
- Growth Opportunity - Join a business targeting significant expansion, with real progression potential
- Creative Freedom - Shape influencer strategy and content approach with autonomy
- Variety - A dynamic mix of field-based work, content creation, and relationship management
- Culture - Be part of a young, energetic, highly collaborative team
- Reward - Competitive salary, bonus after probation, and flexible working approach

title: PR Assistant
description:
Location: Birmingham

Hours: Full time

Salary: £32,000

Contract: Permanent

THE ROLE

As PR Assistant, you will play a key role in helping to promote and grow the business through creative storytelling. Reporting to the Head of PR and working alongside the PR & Social Media Executive, you will support the delivery of external communications, developing PR that stands out, enhances the firm's brand and protects its reputation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE PR ASSISTANT

PR
- Assisting the Head of PR in growing the PR strategy in line with business development campaigns and initiatives
- Generating news stories and PR hooks
- Building relationships with journalists and key stakeholders
- Researching new media outlets and making recommendations for pitches
- Drafting and distributing press releases, briefings and Q&A documents for key target national, trade and regional press
- Working with media platforms to track all coverage and developing various reports
- Maintaining and developing a wide range of media lists
- Attending meetings with teams and partners
- Working closely with the internal comms team to ensure alignment on news and content

Digital content creation
- Uploading news articles, press releases and profile pages to the website
- Working with the team on promoting PR across social media channels
- Supporting the team in the recording and promoting of podcasts

General
- Supporting the Head of PR with admin and general activity, picking up ad hoc duties as they arise
- Dealing with general enquiries as they arise
- Providing general assistance across the whole team as required

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- 2-3 years PR experience, gained within an existing PR background (PR agency and professional services environment desirable)
- Experienced in PR and communications concepts and practices
- Excellent communication and writing skills
- Excels in creating interesting content
- Well-organised, able to work to deadlines
- Ability to think outside the box with an eye for detail
- Creative and confident in liaising with senior teams and presenting
- CIM/PR qualifications or a desire to study them desirable
- Ability to turn technical information into interesting news, with creative flair
- Ability to use initiative and work with limited supervision, with a positive, proactive approach
- Understanding of social media
- Keen interest in the news agenda
- Ability to prioritise work and meet deadlines under pressure
- A strong team player, ready to help colleagues
- Well presented with a polite, professional manner
- Flexible and committed, willing to work outside office hours and travel within the UK as required
- Excellent IT skills, including MS Office

This is a great opportunity for a PR Assistant with an existing PR background to join a top international law firm and take on a varied, creative role within a busy Marketing and BD team.

If you have the skills and experience outlined above and are looking for your next step as a PR Assistant, apply today.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
